description:
You can now add this bundle in ReVanced Manager with a link instead of downloading it:
`https://raw.githubusercontent.com/notBrian2/revanced-rif-fixes/main/bundles/stable.json`

No patch changes since v1.0.0: Fix Reddit galleries, Fix load more comments, Fix Redgifs, Fix imgur album thumbnails and Fix imgur title links for rif is fun golden platinum 5.6.22. Patch your **original** rif 5.6.22 APK together with the official **Spoof client** patch (and MojiRS's rif patches if you like).
